scenario: IRET.10.7 / LGRA.10.1.4: both the `on response` and the `timeout` bodies withdraw `j`, and only the response arrives. So the Job is withdrawn once, by the response body, and the timeout never runs: ["reply", "gone 1"]. PATH PINNED: two continuation siblings sharing one capture fact, each carrying its own ACTION_WITHDRAW_BY_ID over the same reference slot (`dsc.rete`). Only the response sibling fires.
rules_ds:
schema SvcReadReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    ok: Bool

service svc.read:
    kwarg n: Int
    response SvcReadReply

schema Anchor scope explicit:
    v: Int

schema Job scope explicit:
    id: Int

rule r:
    Job j
->
    call svc.read n: j.id cooldown: 1_min as "c1"
        on response.ok == true:
            log info "reply"
            withdraw j
        timeout 30_s:
            log info "timed out"
            withdraw j

rule gone:
    Anchor a
    no Job
->
    log info "gone {a.v}"
